title: KFC Employee Gets Arrested At Work After Threatening Burger King Staff
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 21st, 2024. Officers were called to a Burger King regarding a man who had been trespassed previously but returned and started harassing various employees. The man then walked over to his job at KFC & when officers approached him there, he refused to identify himself leading for the officers to detain him. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
